svg.title: Implementation evidence distinguishes adoption from payment
svg.desc: Thirty-eight sequences support bounded lifecycle descriptions; 1,230 remain on hold. Nineteen adopted sequences have no paid stage observed in the retained evidence—this does not mean they were never paid.

g.text: Implementation evidence distinguishes adoption from payment

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'Inter', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Adoption, amendment, implementation, and payment remain distinct stages

text.style: font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'Inter', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Unit: deduplicated implementation sequence • 38 reviewed; 1,230 held; denominator = 1,268 • Evidence: strict reviewed sequences

text.style: font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'Inter', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #6b7280

g.text: “No paid stage observed in retained evidence” is not “never paid.”
